title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast 2000 Go Double Apple Prefilled Pod & Refill
description: Double Apple from the Dojo Blast 2000 Go range blends the tangy bite of Green Apple with the mellow sweetness of Red Apple for a layered fruit profile. Both notes are distinct yet complementary, offering a satisfying balance of orchard-fresh flavour from start to finish. This pack includes a 2ml transparent pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a 2ml refill container, giving you up to 2,000 puffs of smooth MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with Vaporesso™s COREX 2.0 Mesh Coil for excellent flavour consistency. The transparent pod allows for quick visual checks of your e-liquid level and installs effortlessly into the Dojo Blast 2000 Go device for a clean, user-friendly experience. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging 2. Remove the red silicone covers from the base and top of the refill pod 3. Attach the 2ml pod to the 2ml refill 4. Insert the combined pod into the Dojo Blast device, twisting to secure 5. Inhale to vape—no buttons or setup required. 6. When finished, replace with a fresh pod+refill pack.
